text:
samir: Quick sync: rolling out redwood-v2.5.0 region-by-region in 10m. Order US -> EU -> APAC. Canary 4% default, 10m pin. Alerting thresholds set.

jules: I'll run a fast capacity + queue depth sweep and post results.

infra-oncall: Preflight results: US free GPUs 98/120 (81%), EU free GPUs 54/70 (77%), APAC free GPUs 19/48 (40%). APAC < 60% threshold.

samir: APAC looks tight. Options: warm-pool +4, reduce APAC canary to 1%, or delay APAC. We'll start US now and decide later.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled by samir. release=redwood-v2.5.0 regions=[us,eu,apac] canary=0.04 pin=10m. Use `/deploy status 1788888888` to follow.

jules: Triggering APAC warm-pool +4 now. ETA ~6m. Starting US canary.

deploy-bot: US canary started (slice s-6001). Observability: https://console/redwood/obs/s-6001

sre-anna: Monitoring US: p95 steady, 500s at baseline, kv_cache_miss_rate normal. US pin completes green.

jules: Starting EU canary now. `/deploy start --release redwood-v2.5.0 --region eu --canary 0.04 --pin 10m`

deploy-bot: EU canary started (slice s-6002).

infra-oncall: APAC warm-pool completed: new free GPUs 26/52 (50%). Still below 60.

mike: APAC still low. I propose APAC micro-canary 0.5% with 20m pin and exclude recently updated hosts. Safer than 1%? Either fine.

samir: Agree on micro-canary + host exclusion. Update the plan and start APAC micro-canary only after staging smoke. `/deploy update 1788888888 --region apac --canary 0.005 --pin 20m`

deploy-bot: APAC config updated: canary=0.5% pin=20m. Exclude rule to be applied.

infra-oncall: Applying temporary routing exclude for hosts apac-hotfix-*. Running staging smoke for APAC now.

infra-oncall: Staging smoke PASS. Starting APAC micro-canary (slice s-6003) at 0.5%.

deploy-bot: :warning: s-6003 reports `kv_cache_miss_rate` spike at +3m (1.2%) and small bump in 500s.

sre-anna: Tracing shows `ShardLookupError` on apac-cache-11 correlated with a recent config push. Initiating rollback for s-6003. `/deploy rollback --slice s-6003 --reason "ShardLookupError apac-cache-11"`

deploy-bot: :arrows_counterclockwise: Rollback complete for slice s-6003. Pin released and traffic reverted.

infra-oncall: Isolating apac-cache-11, running config-sync and restarting kv router. Will run extended staging smoke when done.

samir: Holding APAC rollout. US/EU remain on v2.5.0. Opening incident INC-2026-999 and adding triage notes. JULES, please coordinate warm-pool adjustments for next window.

jules: Created INC-2026-999 with logs + obs links. Will follow up with a short plan for next attempt (verify shard maps, avoid apac-cache-11 in canary, micro-canary then ramp).

samir: Thanks team. If infra reports staging green we'll regroup and re-attempt APAC micro-canary. Ping this thread with updates. :thumbsup:
